data.one_liner: A customizable PIN and OTP input field widget for Flutter with headless core and Material support.
data.what_it_does: Provides highly customizable PIN and OTP input fields with support for shapes, animations, validation, form integration, and a headless core mode for complete UI customizability.
use_when: You need OTP or SMS code verification fields in your app.
You want support for custom PIN shapes like outlined, filled, underlined, or circle.
You require a headless architecture to build a completely custom PIN input layout.
avoid_when: You are not using the material_ui package ecosystem required by version 10.x.
strengths: Supports headless architecture for complete UI customization freedom.
Built-in error handling with shake animations and form integration.
Comprehensive styling options including text gradients, custom cursors, and obscure characters.
weaknesses: Version 10.x requires migration to the decoupled material_ui package.
Tightly coupled to specific design system package requirements.
data.setup_notes: Requires material_ui package and matching Flutter version compatibility.

alternatives.name: pinput
alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative standalone PIN input package for Flutter.

data.minimal_example:
MaterialPinField(
  length: 6,
  onCompleted: (pin) => print('PIN: $pin'),
  onChanged: (value) => print('Changed: $value'),
  theme: MaterialPinTheme(
    shape: MaterialPinShape.outlined,
    cellSize: Size(56, 64),
    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
  ),
)
